1.

Soul and tongue may praise God, our Father’s, holy name, He His only Son to us sent As a spotless sacrificial Lamb. He from the grave, according to Scripture, Now in glory stands forth.

2.

He to us has become the light, the life; He is our righteousness. He His Spirit to us sent, And brings us to glory. Christ has won, that we have found Sons’ place in eternity.

3.

We are redeemed, the serpent is crushed, The enemy’s and death’s power Is bound from that moment, When all is subjected to Thee. Christ the life for us has given And God’s grace in the light brought.

4.

Gladly our tongue may praise The Son’s power and glory And bring home to the Father glory For so great mercy. God we praise for His gift Now and in all eternity.
